title: First Moving Enemy Wave
prompt:
Ashe reaches a natural high point on the mid-west side of the Garreg Mach mock battle map as Dorothea, Lorenz, and Ignatz begin moving from the center-west lane. Ashe uses a wooden training bow and disciplined sightline to slow their advance without lethal injury. Behind him, Annette and Mercedes hold the Blue Lions rear line. The environment is grass, stone path, low wall, and thicket cover, not an archery range. Youthful academy students, controlled nonlethal exercise.

Cinematic continuity: Block=Mock Battle Expanded. Transition in: cut on Byleth gesture toward the mid-west route. Transition out: bowstring snap motivates the Golden Deer thicket flank. Screen/camera rule: Ashe pressures from southeast/high side toward mid-west movement; enemies advance through map terrain, not a range lane. Audio bridge: bowstring, soft target thud, student footwork. Generate with 2s editorial handle where possible; begin and end with usable motion, not a frozen poster. Maintain direction, eyelines, and spatial geography from adjacent shots.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. Show tactical pressure through blocking, posture, sound and editing rather than aging faces.

Camera: long-lens archer profile with enemy movement depth below

Scene09 production gate: do not generate final video from the blocked source image if it is SVG or legacy training-yard raster. Use production_image_path after a real cinematic raster keyframe is generated and QA-approved.
Character continuity gate: every named character must match the listed selected.png reference assets for face, hair, age, costume silhouette, and color accents.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; use controlled academy sparring only, no blood or lethal injury. Avoid: straw targets, target lanes, shooting arrows into bodies, brown hair Ashe, blond Ashe, modern archery gear, lethal injury, text, watermark
